$Comment: The Headless Horseman's graveyard intro: the camera sweep each player watches as they arrive in
either graveyard (both dungeon files name it as Area.IntroCamera, and both prefabs share one layout).
Positions are blocks from the prefab's anchor, the entrance room's floor block; +Z runs south into
the graveyard, the fountain sits near Z 53, his spawn marker at Z 46 and his fight's entity at Z 66,
and the black sky is at Y 33, so keep the camera between Y 3 and Y 30.
The shot cuts to a high view over the entrance gate looking down the graveyard, glides south over
the graves toward the fountain, drifts while looking at his ground, then sweeps back down to just
outside the entrance room's door (Z 5), holds a moment and cuts back to the player's own eyes behind
it, about 5.6 seconds in all. The cut keeps the camera from flying through the closed door. Movement
is held while it plays and comes back the moment the view does. Lengthen a keyframe's Seconds to
